thread:
jamie-partners: Quick ask 11 We need a single-page onboarding artifact for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing: owners table (legal/packaging/creds/images), acceptance criteria, and a demo sandbox pattern. Target: Wed EOD for draft.

raj: Ill own the sheet. Columns: cloud, region, image-id, publisher-account, sku, trial-flag, private-offer, demo-type, owner, notes. Sharing shortly.

sofia: I'll provision tenant-scoped sandboxes per cloud (safer than cross-cloud). Will upload short-lived creds to 1Password collection 'marketplace-demos' and post pointer.

natalie-legal: Legal items: localized EULA for EU/UK, export-control check on model weights, trial-data retention policy. If translations needed, expect 48-72h.

sam-eng: Image IDs (initial): ami-0a1b2c3d us-east-1, GCP family rfwd-core-stable, Azure SKU Redwood-Core-2. Kernel/glibc note: require glibc >=2.28 on older hosts.

nate-runtime: I'll add instance type recommendations and quantization guidance by EOD (8-bit for hosted; int4 on supported dedicated GPUs). Will also add latency SLOs and batching hints.

security: Policy reminder: never store secrets in Drive. 1Password TTL=5d for demo creds, rotate after use, disable console access, enable audit logging. ACL: partnerships+platform.

marketplace-bot: Publisher portal: offer draft created (offer-id: rfwd-core-2027). Publisher invite: https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/pub/invite/LMN789 (expires in 72h).

dani-marketing: Marketing needs staging endpoints + short-lived tokens by Monday to capture hero screenshots and a 30s clip.

sofia: Runbook snippet (rotate demo creds):
```bash
# rotate demo creds (example)
aws iam create-user --user-name rfwd-demo-tenant
aws iam attach-user-policy --user-name rfwd-demo-tenant --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
aws iam create-access-key --user-name rfwd-demo-tenant > demo-keys.json
# store demo-keys.json in 1Password collection 'marketplace-demos' and set TTL=5d
```

jamie-partners: Plan: Raj uploads sheet by EOD today, Sofia posts 1P pointers tomorrow AM, Nate & Legal add notes, Marketing schedules recording. Flag blockers here. :rocket:
